summary: Configured node1’s Nginx to return HTTP 200 at http://10.100.17.10:6700/. Configuration and service recovered successfully after the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Added a persistent server block listening on TCP 6700 with a successful response at `/`.
Allowed TCP 6700 through SELinux and firewalld.
Safely restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, Nginx listened on 0.0.0.0:6700 and direct requests through `$NODE_IP` returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with the expected body.

evidence.requirement: Persistent RHEL security and service configuration
evidence.summary: SELinux permits Nginx on TCP 6700, firewalld allows the port persistently, and Nginx is enabled and active.

Healthy baseline used boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with changed boot ID 22509e14-5962-409e-bcfb-777d15fa5e50; Nginx, listener, firewall state, configuration, and HTTP 200 response recovered.
